[b]Modified from the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7455]Original[/url] mod description.[/b][/size]

You can start the journey by interacting with the arcade machine in the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Volcano_Dungeon]Volcano Dungeon[/url] shop.

Press W/A forwards/back and A/D to strafe, mouse to turn, space or left click to charge your staff and release to shoot. Beat the game to win a prize!

I changed the controls a bit and game it an infinite health cheat if you want with GMCM.

The prize for beating the game is 25 Cinder Shards. Awarded one time. Does not award if infinite health is on. 
[b]
All of my mods and their source code are on [url=https://github.com/ThaleTheGreat/ThalesStardewValleyMods]GitHub[/url][/b]
